head: 87480eb410acc467efb835c7abde502432f166ab
summary:
The build does what the design and the accepted review decisions (M2, M3, m2, m3, m4) asked, and every departure is declared. TopLevelTracker captures (Bytes, OnDisk) when a row's pending count reaches 0: in FolderExited at TopLevelTracker.cs:95-96, and in Seed for file and link rows at :72-73. Build latches Revised when a Done row's figures differ from that capture (:195-196) and publishes it through the one construction site (:198-201). Moved is unchanged. TitleOf has the one `Done when row.Revised` arm (TopLevelRowText.cs:33). I read Scanner.cs:152-165 and 413-450: SizeFiles, the only path to Correct→Credit(inPlace)→Moved, runs after the listing loop has emptied _pending, and both calls assert _owner.Check(). So the M1 and M4 overrides (order is structural, no lock) hold as stated. I re-ran the checks. The acceptance command exits 0 (10/10). The full default Core.Tests suite passes (381/381). The engine's Fitness holds all 61 rules. The listing template has a single title binding (MainWindow.xaml:401), which both RefreshTopLevel and ShowFinalTopLevel reach through ShowTopLevel (MainWindow.xaml.cs:320-357). Every case-matrix row I read feeds its shape in. C-009 is the one the build says it did not test, but in practice it is exercised: the acceptance and C-010 run at the default 250 ms interval and the repro finishes in about 23 ms, so '1-folder' is never published as an unrevised Done before the correction lands. There is one gap, and it is in coverage, not behaviour. The file-row settle branch in Seed has no positive test. I ran a scratch scan with a stale hardlink name directly under the root: the row came out 'a-stale.bin File Done 67108864 revised=True', so it works today. Nothing guards it, though, and C:\Windows' own root files are hardlinks.

Second round: Second round: I tried to break the two fitness rules this diff adds and the paths around the tracker and converter. I planted a CRLF file directly under src/FsAnalyser.App and ran the engine's Fitness with a rebuild. The Core-side set rule `\bRevised\s*=(?![=>])` catches a set split across a CRLF line break, and the `src/FsAnalyser.*/**/*.cs` glob covers files sitting directly in the project folder (zero directories for `**`). The App reader rule `\.Revised\b` catches a dotted read. A WPF read of the flag in XAML is NOT caught: `<DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Revised}" ...>` in a .xaml file under src/FsAnalyser.App passed with 'Every declared rule holds'. The rule's files glob is `*.cs` only, and this repo's own convention pairs every App rule of this kind with a *.xaml twin (SL-044 m6, and the reparse-attribute rule). That is the one new finding. The builder's follow-up already recorded the property-pattern miss (`{ Revised: true }`), so it is not refiled. I removed the plants and rebuilt; the tree is back to 'Every declared rule holds' with the same git status as at the start. The tracker boundaries I re-checked hold: aborted listings never reach FolderExited, so they never settle; negative and zero deltas; an empty root; Link rows settled at Seed but never Done; rebuilds only through MarkDirty; and Finish after a cancel during the probe pass. The test helpers' error paths hold too: the mklink failure throws, and the finally blocks delete each tree.

findings.claim: The file-row half of the settled capture has no test that feeds its shape in. Seed settles every row whose pending count starts at 0 (file and link rows, TopLevelTracker.cs:72-73), and a later probe correction of a top-level FILE row goes through Moved with no parent walk (parent == _root). Every Revised test builds folder rows: C-001 to C-004 use HandDriven over folders a/b, and the acceptance, C-008 and C-010 use '1-folder'. The watcher in TopLevelTests only guards the negative side, that a row is never marked in the snapshot it settled in. So a change that marks by kind, or that builds file rows before Settle and sets the latch in the same Build, would go uncaught. The shape is realistic: C:\Windows' root files (explorer.exe, notepad.exe and others) are hardlinks with WinSxS names, and the root listing charges them first. I measured the behaviour as correct today with a scratch console on a fresh tree (root\a-stale.bin hardlinked to sub\current.bin, grown by 63 MiB through the sub name): Completed, 'a-stale.bin File Done 67108864 revised=True' and 'sub Folder Done 0 revised=False'. This is a guard for later, not a defect now.
findings.evidence: src/FsAnalyser.Core/TopLevelTracker.cs:72-73 (the Seed settle branch) and :120-123 (the Moved walk, which is skipped for a root child). tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/TopLevelTests.cs:440-596 (every HandDriven row is a folder). tests/bugs/SL-063-DoneRowFinality/DoneRowFinalityTests.cs (every revised row is '1-folder').
findings.fix: Add one real-tree Fact to TopLevelTests. Put a stale hardlink name directly under the root: TempTree.Hardlink(root\a-stale.bin, sub\current.bin), then TempTree.Append(current, 63 MiB). Watch it with correctedRows: ["a-stale.bin"] and assert that the File row is Done at 64 MiB with Revised true, and that 'sub' is not Revised.

findings.claim: The rule 'in the App only the row converter reads a top-level row's Revised flag' covers only C#, so the most idiomatic second reader in this WPF app gets through. A binding in XAML, such as `<DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Revised}" Value="True">` to italicise a revised row, or `{Binding Path=Revised}`, reads the flag outside TopLevelRowText. That is the drift the rule's `because` exists to stop ('a row can read as final in one place and revised in another'). MainWindow.xaml already binds row properties by bare name everywhere (`{Binding Name}`, `{Binding SizeText}`, DataTriggers at :181-277), and the list's row template sits in that file (:398-405). I measured it: a planted src/FsAnalyser.App/ZzSl063Plant.xaml holding that DataTrigger passed Fitness with 'Every declared rule holds', while the .cs plant beside it was flagged. The repo already knows this shape. .taad/fitness.yaml:541-557 pairs 'the window does not sort the folder tree in its XAML either' with its code twin, 'One entry per file type, because files takes one glob' (SL-044 review m6), and :105-106 gives the reparse rule a 'src/**/*.xaml' twin. The SL-063 rule has no twin.
findings.evidence: .taad/fitness.yaml, the SL-063 entry `files: src/FsAnalyser.App/**/*.cs`, `must_not_match: '\.Revised\b'`. The precedents are .taad/fitness.yaml:105-116 and :541-557. The plant run was Fitness op=check with rebuild=true: the rule flagged ZzSl063Plant.cs:6 (`r.Revised`) and left ZzSl063Plant.xaml:4 (`Binding="{Binding Revised}"`) unflagged. Both plants were deleted afterwards.
findings.fix: Add a twin entry to .taad/fitness.yaml: `name: in the App's XAML nothing reads a top-level row's Revised flag`, `files: src/FsAnalyser.App/*.xaml` (or `src/FsAnalyser.App/**/*.xaml`), `must_not_match: ['\bRevised\b']`, with the same `because`. No except_files is needed, since the converter is C#. Check it with the same plant.

obligations.evidence: I re-ran `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/bugs/SL-063-DoneRowFinality/SL-063-DoneRowFinality.Tests.csproj`: exit 0, 10 passed, 0 failed. The acceptance body (DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:39-79) looks unchanged. The NotEqual moved from line 66 to line 73, which matches exactly the 7 using lines added for the new tests. The original file is not in git, so I cannot diff it byte for byte.

Under M2 the Done check does not happen in Moved. TopLevelTracker.Build (TopLevelTracker.cs:187-196) computes state==Done and compares against SettledBytes/SettledOnDisk. Those are captured on the same thread when pending reaches 0 (:95-96 FolderExited, :72-73 Seed). The tracker takes no lock (remarks :13-14), and Scanner.Correct and Credit call _owner.Check() (Scanner.cs:415, 444), so no interleaving is possible.

Scanner.cs:152-163: the `while (_pending.Count > 0)` listing loop ends before `SizeFiles()`, the only caller of Correct→Credit(inPlace:true)→_topLevel.Moved (Scanner.cs:399, 432, 449). DoneRowFinalityTests.TheCorrectionLandsAfterTheRowSettledInEveryRun (:174-195) builds 20 fresh stale trees and asserts Completed, Done, 4 MiB and Revised=true in each. A pre-settle correction would leave Revised false, so the test would catch a reorder. Passed in my run.
TopLevelTests.cs:440-462, a Theory over completed true/false. Row a settles Done at 1 MiB, Move +63 MiB marks it, the move back keeps the mark, and Finish keeps it. Passed in the 381-test run.
TopLevelTests.cs:468-482. ListB with a pushed sub keeps b Reading, and Move +63 MiB does not mark it. ListBSub then settles b at 64 MiB, still unmarked, and it stays so at Finish.
TopLevelTests.cs:488-503, InlineData (0,0,false), (0,4096,true) and (100,0,true), with Assert.NotSame proving the row was rebuilt.
TopLevelTests.cs:509-524. Both rows are Done, then two Moved calls (-1 MiB on a, +1 MiB on b) mark both, and the rows still sum to the snapshot's bytes.
DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:87-110. A real scan that asserts no entry carries ProbeCorrected; every row is Done, not Revised, and titled with its bare name.
DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:39-79, the acceptance fact. It now passes, with TitleOf returning '1-folder  (revised)'.
DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:117-128, a Theory over all 6 TopLevelStates with Revised set both ways through reflection on the internal ctor and the init setter.

DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:136-165. Two real MainWindows: one driven through the private RefreshTopLevel with _progress set, the other through ShowFinalTopLevel. It reads the first TextBlock of each realised ListBoxItem, which is the RowTitle binding at MainWindow.xaml:401. Both return '1-folder  (revised)' and '2-folder'.
Same as O-003: TheCorrectionLandsAfterTheRowSettledInEveryRun, 20 fresh trees. The structural reason is written in docs/design/SL-063-done-row-revised.md:45-54.

TopLevelTracker.cs:72-73 and :95-96 capture Settle(). :195-196 latch r.Revised. :198-201 publish it through the single `new TopLevelRow(...)` site, the only one in src (grep). Moved (:116-131) is unchanged.

.taad/fitness.yaml, 'only the tracker sets a top-level row's Revised flag': `\bRevised\s*=(?![=>])` over src/FsAnalyser.*/**/*.cs, excepting only TopLevelTracker.cs. The lookahead is a declared deviation, needed because the decided literal would match TopLevelRowText.cs:33 `when row.Revised =>`. Fitness check: all 61 rules hold.

The TitleOf state×Revised matrix is in the bug project (DoneRowFinalityTests.cs:117-128). The `\.Revised\b` App rule, excepting TopLevelRowText.cs, is in .taad/fitness.yaml. The binding half is exercised by the C-008 window test.
A grep for 'revision wording', 'mid-scan report stays untouched' and 'only the tracker's Moved path' finds no rule in .taad/fitness.yaml. Only the two structural SL-063 rules exist.

docs/design/SL-063-done-row-revised.md:59-69, 'Why nothing is marked in advance'. It gives the three restated reasons, labels the 3.0% as folder-level, and limits the MS hard-links citation to what the page says.

cases.evidence: TopLevelTests.ANonZeroCorrectionOfADoneRowMarksItRevisedForTheRestOfTheScan: row a is asserted Done and unmarked, then tracker.Moved(+63 MiB) is followed by Corrected, and the row is Done at 64 MiB and Revised. It also covers the latch after moving back, and both Finish endings.
TopLevelTests.ACorrectionOfARowStillReadingDoesNotMarkIt: b has sub pushed and is asserted Reading before Moved. It is not marked then, or after it settles.
TopLevelTests.ACorrectionOfADoneRowMarksItOnlyWhenAFigureMoved: Moved(0,0) on a Done row, with NotSame proving a rebuild, leaves it unmarked. The single-figure moves mark it.

TopLevelTests.AChargeMovingBetweenTwoDoneRowsMarksBoth: both rows are settled Done first, then -1 MiB on a and +1 MiB on b. Both end Revised. In the real scanner Moved credits one row per call, so two calls is the faithful shape.
DoneRowFinalityTests.ADoneRowNothingCorrectedStillReadsItsBareName: a real scan that asserts no ProbeCorrected entry. Every row is Done, not Revised, and titled with its bare name.
The acceptance: a real stale-hardlink tree, 1-folder Done at 64 MiB, and a title that is not its bare name. Passes.
DoneRowFinalityTests.TheMarkShowsOnlyOnADoneRow: 6 InlineData, one per TopLevelState, each with Revised=true and Revised=false through reflection.

DoneRowFinalityTests.TheResultsListShowsTheMarkOnATickAndAtTheEnding: the same scan's rows go through RefreshTopLevel (tick) and ShowFinalTopLevel (ending) in real MainWindows, and the test reads the realised title TextBlock. The tick renders the final snapshot, because the scan has already returned, but it goes through the same RefreshTopLevel→ShowTopLevel path.

The build says there is no test, but the acceptance and C-010 run at the default 250 ms TopLevelInterval, and the repro finishes in about 23 ms. Seed publishes once, and neither FolderExited nor Corrected publishes again before Finish. So '1-folder' is never published as an unrevised Done, and the tests assert it is marked, which is the over-marking the design accepted. This depends on timing, not on anything deterministic.

DoneRowFinalityTests.TheCorrectionLandsAfterTheRowSettledInEveryRun: 20 fresh trees, each asserting Revised=true. A correction before the row settled would be captured in the settled figures and leave Revised false, so the test catches the race the case names.

drift: C-008 (DoneRowFinalityTests.TheResultsListShowsTheMarkOnATickAndAtTheEnding) drives real MainWindows from xUnit, reaching the private members `_progress`, `RefreshTopLevel` and `ShowFinalTopLevel` by reflection. The project's recorded testing lines say App window state is verified through the published exe's --report and FsaWindowHook, with 'no xUnit App test project'. Decision m2 sanctioned only the TitleOf converter matrix in the bug project. The build reports C-008 as the window-level proof but does not declare it as a departure from that stack decision. It lives outside FsAnalyser.slnx, so the default suite never runs it, and renaming either private method fails it with MissingMethodException.

The build lists C-009 as 'no test', but the acceptance and C-010 exercise it in practice: at the default 250 ms interval the repro's '1-folder' is never published as an unrevised Done before the correction lands, and both tests assert that it is marked.
